candidates.description: These tokens represent various characters and sub-word units from Indic scripts, primarily Devanagari.
This vector represents characters and letter clusters from the Devanagari script used for languages like Hindi.
This vector activates for Hindi consonants combined with the vowel sign 'ा' or similar vowel modifiers, particularly sharing the character sequence 'च'.
This vector represents Devanagari vowel signs and related punctuation commonly used in Hindi text.
This vector activates on common Hindi consonant clusters and syllable endings, particularly involving the letter 'त' (ta) and 'र' (ra).
These tokens represent common suffixes and inflectional endings used in Hindi verb conjugations.
This vector represents Devanagari vowel signs, nasalization markers, and specific consonant characters used in Hindi script.
This vector represents Devanagari script characters, conjuncts, and vowel signs used in Hindi and related Indic languages.
This feature vector represents consecutive integers around the number 188.
This vector represents subword fragments and non-Latin script tokens with no unified semantic concept.
